s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic vision disturbance with signs of intraocular inflammation and macular edema
salient_findings: Cystoid macular edema with subfoveal fluid
Keratic precipitates and cells in the anterior chamber
key_facts: Blurry vision in right eye for several months
On anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years
Conjunctival injection and fine keratic precipitates in right eye
Cystoid macular edema with yellow spot in fovea in right eye
Normal blood tests for vasculitis and rheumatologic disorders
Unremarkable computed tomography of the chest

shortlist.label: Intraocular inflammation associated with anastrozole
shortlist.why_kept: Patient on anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years, presenting with intraocular inflammation

shortlist.label: Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of bilateral iritis and presence of keratic precipitates

shortlist.label: Intermediate uveitis
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of cystoid macular edema and cells in the anterior chamber

shortlist.label: Pars planitis
shortlist.why_kept: History of bilateral iritis and presence of cystoid macular edema

shortlist.label: Uveitis associated with cytomegalovirus
shortlist.why_kept: Intraocular inflammation with cystoid macular edema, although less likely given normal blood tests

raw.rationale: The patient's history of anastrozole therapy for more than 2 years and the presence of intraocular inflammation, including conjunctival injection, fine keratic precipitates, and cystoid macular edema, suggest a link between the anastrozole therapy and the ocular symptoms.

rejected.label: Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis
rejected.why: Lack of heterochromia and characteristic findings of Fuchs heterochromic iridocyclitis in the vignette

rejected.label: Intermediate uveitis
rejected.why: No inflammation in the periphery was noted in either eye, which is not typical for intermediate uveitis

rejected.label: Pars planitis
rejected.why: No characteristic snowbanking or snowballs were mentioned, and the patient's age and presentation are not typical for pars planitis

rejected.label: Uveitis associated with cytomegalovirus
rejected.why: No evidence of cytomegalovirus infection was provided, and the patient's presentation and history do not suggest this diagnosis
